title: Izikali Ezawela Entshabalalweni
intro: Kwindawo echumileyo nechumayo, uluntu oluchumayo luvumele ukubawa konakalise indawo yentengiso. Eyaziwa ngobuchule borhwebo kunye nobuninzi obuvela kwiigadi ezingqongileyo, eli qela lajongana nobizo lobulungisa nokholo. Kodwa ukuzingca ngobutyebi kwakhokelela ekungavumi, kwaye ithunzi elimnyama lahlangana elundini.
clues: Sasiluluntu olurhweba kakuhle oluhlala phakathi kweegadi kunye nemithi eneemithi.
Sasiqhatha abantu ngemilinganiselo nangezikali, sisasaza urhwaphilizo elizweni.
Salumkiswa sisithunywa sethu ukuba sinqule uAllah kuphela size sinikele ngemilinganiselo epheleleyo.
Simhleka usulu umthunywa wethu saza safuna isohlwayo ukuba unyanisile.
Sabanjwa sisohlwayo seMini yoMthunzi xa ilifu lasigubungela.
Ndaziwa ngokuba ngabahlobo basehlathini, abantu uShu'ayb awayethunyelwe kubo.
